cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

mechanism: A makes a departing person's grooming choices await superior approval, creating further inspection reasons without asking them to stay.
confusable: Unlike ordinary helpful delay, A must treat questions as petitions and use that approval power to extend presence.
comparison: An interview tie inspection contrasts with travel luggage being repeatedly approved in the other alternative.
seedUse: Canonical S01-a supplies approval of ordinary behavior; D02-a supplies departure pressure and a help task that creates another reason to remain. New tie setting is independently authored.
